name: io.github.tonyyang0504/matterhorn-mcp
description: Matterhorn (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. Every too

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MATTERHORN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Matterhorn REST API key generated in the customer panel (free for registered wholesale customers), sent as the raw Authorization header value.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MATTERHORN_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Order currency for create_order (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP); left out of the body when unset.
